clips.title: The story
paras: The Pendant of the Sea Lion is a sacred druidic talisman representing the union of aquatic agility and endurance. Assembled at the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade, it serves as proof that an initiate is ready to master their aquatic form.

To claim the aquatic aspect of the sea lion, a druid must prove mastery over the water's greatest hazards. The pendant is created by recovering two distinct halves: one embodying the agility needed to slip past aquatic predators, and the other granting the endurance required to withstand prolonged submersion. Brought before the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade, the two pieces are joined into a single whole.

Once forged, the completed pendant is brought before elder mentors—such as Turak Runetotem on the towering rises of Thunder Bluff or Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus. The talisman provides undeniable proof of the initiate's trials under Dendrite Starblaze, permitting the elders to bestow the secrets of shifting into an aquatic form.
